adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` is normalized to lowercase (`map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guests` values are not lowercased/trimmed before comparisons. The filter uses `guest === attendee.email` and `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`, both case-sensitive, so `Guest@Example.com` could bypass the blacklist or be treated as distinct from an existing attendee with `guest@example.com`. The claim about duplication from the booking flow isn’t verifiable from this diff, but the inconsistent normalization and resulting behavior is directly evidenced here.
